en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing a straight, tree‑lined avenue receding into the distance toward low buildings at the base of a large forested hill or mountain. The view is taken from behind a stone balustrade, likely from a bridge or terrace, with decorative streetlamps featuring multiple round globes visible in the foreground and along the street. A few pedestrians and a horse‑drawn or early motor vehicle are on the road. There is no visible printed caption on the image side.
